purpose: Teach: 硫黄/料亭/銅像/寒天/紋章/紫色/食肉/露店

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、硫黄泉の温泉旅行をされたんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, one of your customers just got back from a sulfur hot spring trip.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Gently sharing something noticed. Soft curiosity—not pressing, just passing along a small kindness.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、料亭の若女将のお仕事だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh, and apparently she works as a junior proprietress at a traditional restaurant.
lines.style: Gentle surprise, continuing the thread. Light tone—a small discovery being offered. Interested without being nosy.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、銅像の修復のお仕事なんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She actually does restoration work on bronze statues—really intricate work.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly impressed. Building a picture of someone. Respectful pause on the detail—acknowledging the skill involved.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、寒天デザート加えましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, we should add an agar dessert to the new menu.
lines.style: Practical turn, lighter energy. Idea landing naturally. Direct but not commanding—more thinking-out-loud with Mei.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、家紋の紋章を見せてくださったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And she showed me her family crest—it was beautiful.
lines.style: Thoughtful, touching on something precious. Quiet respect. Drawing out the moment gently—a privilege witnessed.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、紫色のスカーフが素敵だね、メイちゃん
lines.en: That purple scarf she wears is really lovely, isn't it?
lines.style: Genuine appreciation, genuine warmth. Noticing the detail because you care. A small compliment offered with real sincerity.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、食肉を控えた野菜中心にしましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Maybe the new menu should focus more on vegetables—less meat, you think?
lines.style: Thoughtful suggestion, gentle conviction. Checking in with Mei. Considerate of something noticed, not imposing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お祭りで露店も出店したいわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I've been thinking—it would be nice to have a stall at the festival this year.
lines.style: Hopeful, wistful ending. Opening a possibility, not demanding. Trailing thought—inviting Mei to imagine it together.
